prompt: Challenge C022-CH3: We want to add a water-balance module so farmers can plan irrigation scheduling, but none of our staff understands evapotranspiration modell

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Reference evapotranspiration is calculated using the FAO Penman-Monteith method, which requires systematic handling of meteorological input data under Pannonian lowland conditions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10778","field":"title","quote":"FAO-PM evapotranspiration estimates to systematic biases in input climate variables"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10775","field":"abstract","quote":"Metoda FAO Penman-Monteith smatra se standardnim pristupom za procenu referentne evapotranspiracije"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Soil water balance modelling at field parcel scale connects reference evapotranspiration estimates with soil moisture measurements and crop water requirements for irrigation scheduling decisions.","sources":[{"id":"R1047","field":"bio","quote":"modeliranjem vodnog bilansa na nivou parcele, procenom referentne evapotranspiracije"},{"id":"R1047","field":"keywords","quote":"soil water balance irrigation scheduling"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Field validation of irrigation scheduling systems requires integration of soil moisture sensor networks with reference evapotranspiration calculations and comparison against measured depletion dynamics.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-06984","field":"abstract","quote":"soil moisture sensors were evaluated over one full sugar beet growing season"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-06984","field":"abstract","quote":"sufficiently to trigger irrigation at the 50% allowable depletion threshold"}]}]}
